description: A unique identifier for each product.
The official name of the product.
An alternative or internal code used to identify the product, often an SKU.
A unique identifier for the product group or category to which the product belongs.
A unique identifier for the broader business division or segment associated with the product.
A unique identifier for the vendor or supplier of the product.
The brand name of the product.
The current selling price of the product.
The timestamp when the product record was first created or added to the system.
